verdict.rationale: Direct probe evidence confirms docs.readme.com serves llms.txt at HTTP 200, and every page also has a markdown mirror variant (URL+.md) that returns full content with agent-oriented instructions, plus a built-in query/retrieval interface over llms.txt. This matches the story closely with first-party and hands-on corroboration. missing for 10: independent third-party (non-ReadMe-authored) confirmation on a customer-hosted (non-docs.readme.com) project rather than ReadMe's own docs site.
